body.statement: Under independent sampling and for certified tolerance \(\delta_N=o(\rho_N)\), the positive Fourier minimum-distance estimator satisfies \(D_H(\theta,\widehat\theta_N)=O_{\mathbb P}(\rho_N)\) and \(d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\theta,\widehat\theta_N)=O_{\mathbb P}\{\rho_N^{(k+1)/(k+m+1)}\}\), uniformly over the model class. In the primary case \(n=2\), \(k=2\), \(m=1\), this is \((N/\log N)^{-3/16}\).
body.justification: A computable estimator turns the population frontier into a usable finite-sample guarantee in the same symmetric quotient geometry, without numerical differentiation at critical points.
body.gap: Acartürk et al. give finite-sample recovery for linear mixers, and Lyu--Fu control a derivative diagnostic for nonlinear ICA; neither handles bounded nonlinear causal decoders or quotient loss.
body.consumer: Implementations on periodic latent coordinates obtain a certified stopping rule and representation error radius from environment samples.
